resources.string: TripAtlas runs on your own server and turns your GPS tracks (Traccar) and photos (Immich) into a map of every trip. Enter the address of your TripAtlas server.
That is not a web address.
No answer from this address. Is the server running, and is the phone in the right network?
%1$s answers, but it is not TripAtlas.
%1$s is reachable without encryption (http). That works at home, but passwords travel unencrypted and the app cannot keep maps and photos for offline use. With https (a reverse proxy) both work.
TripAtlas is free, open-source software (AGPL). You install it yourself with Docker next to Traccar and Immich; the guide explains every step.
Then %1$s signs in on this phone with the fingerprint, also when switching accounts. The password stays encrypted on the phone.
